content: Supabase Auth supports disabling login without deleting the user via supabase.auth.admin.updateUserById(userId, { ban_duration: '876000h' }) (server-only, requires service role key). Set ban_duration to 'none' to unban. No new npm package needed — this is part of @supabase/supabase-js's GoTrue admin client, already installed. Requires a server-only admin client (service role key, never exposed to browser) which this project does not yet have.
